title: Private Helicopter 77 Miles Fireworks Tour over all Theme Parks
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Helicopter tour (duration based on option selected)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Arrival time: passengers must arrive 20 minutes prior to their scheduled departure. If you do not arrive within the specified timeframe, please contact us.
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required

Reschedule/Cancellation Policy: A full refund or reschedule requires at least 24 hours in advance of the start date of the experience. No refunds will be given after that time period. Although all flight times are approximate and subject to change due to weather conditions and weight restrictions. If it is cancelled due to inclement weather (heavy rain, low cloud ceilings, lightning, or extreme winds), you will be offered a different date or a full refund.
Infants up to 2 years old (under 30lb/14kg) must sit on a lap and will fly for free.
We require all the Adults' passengers IDs.
Weight restrictions: One person CANNOT exceed 300lbs (136kg/21.4st) and the total weight for 3 people is 600lbs (272kg/42.8st). All passengers must be willing to be weighed for safety.
policies: Please note that only the 40-45 min tour includes Fireworks
It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. Every seat is a window seat on this exciting Helicopter Tour!
Failure in showing up for your appointment without notice will result in cancellation of your tour without refund.
People per ride: The helicopter fits 3 passengers at a time so if you have a party of 4 people or more, we will have to split them in two or more rides.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
40-45 min Fireworks Tour - 77 Miles - This tour is a 40-45 minute experience of all the theme parks at night plus an amazing fireworks show! This is a must do when you are in Orlando! (note: Times vary based on the time of the year. Please keep that in mind
when booking this tour.) Not only will you catch a Fireworks show from the air but you will also see Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Disney Springs, Universal Studios, Volcano Bay and the Orlando Eye shining bright with all of their spectacular lights. 
It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. Every seat is a window seat on this exciting Helicopter Tour! See the magic and hear the original soundtrack to match the show with premium sound headsets! We are the only tour company that provides a FULL show experience with sound!
